newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INVICTA SEES BIG VOLUMES AFTER SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: INVICTA SEES BIG VOLUMES AFTER SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Share volumes in South Africa's Invicta Holdings Ltd surged on Friday following a bookover deal involving 10 million shares worth around 58 million rand by stockbrokers Huysamer Stals, dealers said.

By about 1042 GMT Invicta, which is an investment holding company with interests in the wholesale and retail of bearings and transmissions equipment, was unchanged at its Thursday's closing price of 580 cents.
It earlier hit an intra-day low of 575 cents.
Huysamer Stals confirmed the deal but could not say if it was related to Invicta's issue of new shares.
Invicta earlier said it would issue 6.5 million new shares from the start of trade on Friday at 550 cents a share. The issue was to strengthen its capital base, fund expansion and reduce debt.
Invicta also has interests in agricultural machinery and implements and automotive parts.
